cards.title: Who moves the order
items: LPS creates the order (Chris ticks lines in the job's Orders tab, or Rosie) with the customer's commitment; lines for a supplier that already has an open order on the job are added to it
New to Processing: the supplier presses Acknowledge Received, which asks for nothing; Rosie can record a confirmation the supplier gave another way
Processing to Order Ready: the supplier or Chris presses Mark as Ready
Moves are forward only: no skipping Processing and no going back

cards.title: Set separately from the stage
items: Pickup or delivery and the target date are the job's; the order has none of its own
While the order is open, Chris edits its Additional details, Change log and rows
The supplier updates row statuses and their own notes

cards.title: How it relates to the job
items: Creating the order moves its job from Quote or Availability to Committed
The job stays Committed through Processing and Order Ready
Won or Lost can be recorded from any open stage, only on Chris's word
Closing the job's last open order closes the job: Won if any of its orders was won, else Lost
A lost order's candidates stay on its rows and cannot be ordered again
